question: Where is Mormugao Port is located?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Goa.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Mormugao port is located in the state of **Goa.**
 
• It is India's** natural and oldest port.**
 
• It is an important port of Goa, located at the entrance of the **Zuary Estury**.
 
• It has contributed largely to the growth of maritime trade in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** New Mangalore port:**

 
 
• It is located in **Dakshina Kannada district**, at a site called **Panambur** of Karnataka.
 
• It is also known as the **Panambur Port.**
 
• It was inaugurated by former prime minister **Indira Gandhi on January 11, 1975.**
 
• It is called New Mangalore Port to distinguish it from the old harbor or port located in Mangalore city which is called Mangalore bunder or Hale bunder.
 
 
 
• **Mumbai port:**
 
 
• The Mumbai port, also known as **Bombay port** is located in the state of Maharashtra.
 
• It is a **natural and the largest port in India.**
 
• Mumbai port is the busiest port in the country and **it handles about one-fifth of the country's total export.**
 
• It has three dock facilities- **Prince's dock, Victoria dock, and Indira dock.**
 
 
 
• **Kolkata port:**
 
 
• The Kolkata port, officially known as the **Syama Prasad Mookerjee Port i**s located in **Kolkata, West Bengal.**
 
• It was constructed by the British East India Company and it played a crucial role in trading during the colonial period.
 
• This port has a** twin dock system- Haldia dock and Kolkata dock **is located on the Eastern bank of River Hoogly.
